reason: V51 is the best P9 balance between color differentiation and Triceratops identity. It adds a cooler blue-gray body with pale mottling, keeps the two brow horns, nasal horn, closed beak, skull-attached frill, long tail, four dinosaur limbs, and separated non-hoofed toes. V49 and v50 are useful review holds for dark speckle and rust-frill variants but do not beat v51 overall.
nextRoute: Use v51 as the current app-first color-pattern smoke-test seed. Future passes should preserve its cool non-sandy palette while improving exact toe anatomy, low elongated anti-rhino torso, and frill/skull proportions through body-lock or localized foot/frill i2i.
